subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right form of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: realize provide give help be render become do serve turn Trees (a) ----- useful to man in three very important ways. They (b) ----- him with wood and other products, they (c) ----- him shade and they (d) ----- him prevent drought drought and floods. Unfortunately, in many parts of the world man has (e) ----- that the third of these services is the most important. However, man has (f) ----- ungrateful to trees which (g) ----- service in many ways. Trees are better than friends because friends may (h) ----- enemy for personal interests whereas trees never (i) ----- any harm to us. They (j) ----- us throughout their lives.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs: (a) are; (b) provide; (c) give; (d) help; (e) not realized; (f) become: (g) render: (h) turn; (i) do; (J) serve.
